90.16: Lord, behold thou into thy servants, and into thy works; and dress thou the sons of them.
90.17: And the shining of our Lord God be on us; and dress thou the works of our hands on us; and dress thou the works of our hands.

91.1: He that dwelleth in the help of the highest God; shall dwell in the protection of God of heaven.
91.2: He shall say to the Lord, Thou art mine up-taker, and my refuge; my God, I shall hope in him.
91.3: For he delivered me from the snare of hunters; and from a sharp word.
91.4: With his shoulders he shall make shadow to thee; and thou shalt have hope under his feathers. His truth shall encompass thee with a shield;
91.5: thou shalt not dread of the night’s dread. Of an arrow flying in the day,
91.6: of a goblin going in darknesses; of assailing, and of a midday fiend.
91.7: A thousand shall fall down from thy side, and ten thousand from thy right side; forsooth it shall not nigh to thee.
91.8: Nevertheless thou shalt behold with thine eyes; and thou shalt see the yielding of sinners.
91.9: For thou, Lord, art mine hope; thou hast set thine help to be the alder Highest.
91.10: Evil shall not come to thee; and a scourge shall not come nigh to thy tabernacle.
91.11: For God hath commanded to his angels of thee; that they keep thee in all thy ways.
91.12: They shall bear thee in the hands; lest peradventure thou hurt thy foot at a stone.
91.13: Thou shalt go upon a snake, and a cockatrice; and thou shalt defoul a lion, and a dragon.
91.14: For God saith, For he hoped in me, I shall deliver him; I shall defend him, for he knew my name.
91.15: He cried to me, and I shall hear him; I am with him in tribulation; I shall deliver him, and I shall glorify him.
91.16: I shall [[ful]] fill him with the length of days; and I shall show mine health to him.

92.1: The psalm of song, in the day of sabbath. It is good to acknowledge to the Lord; and to sing to thy name, thou Highest.
92.2: To show early thy mercy; and thy truth by night.
92.3: In a psaltery of ten cords; with song in harp.
92.4: For thou, Lord, hast delighted me in the works of thy making; and I shall make full out joy in the works of thine hands.
92.5: Lord, thy works be magnified greatly; thy thoughts be made full deep.
92.6: An unwise man shall not know; and a fool shall not understand these things.
92.7: When sinners come forth, as hay; and all they appear, that work wicked-ness. That they perish into the world of world;
92.8: forsooth thou, Lord, art the Highest, without end.
92.9: For lo! Lord, thine enemies, for lo! thine enemies shall perish; and all they shall be scattered that work wickedness.
92.10: And mine horn shall be raised as an unicorn; and mine eld age shall be in plenteous mercy.
92.11: And mine eye despised mine enemies; and when wicked men rise against me, mine ear shall hear of their downfall.
92.12: A just [[or rightwise]] man shall flower as a palm tree; he shall be multiplied as a cedar of Lebanon.
92.13: Men planted in the house of the Lord; shall flower in the porches of the house of our God.
92.14: Yet they shall be multiplied in plenteous eld age; and they shall be suffering well.
92.15: That they tell, that our Lord God is rightful [[or right]]; and no wicked-ness is in him.

93.1: The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with fairness; the Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded himself. For he made steadfast the world; that shall not be moved.
93.2: God, thy seat was made ready from that time; thou art from the world.
93.3: Lord, the floods have raised; the floods have raised their voice. Floods have raised their waves; of the voices of many waters.
93.4: The raisings of the sea be wonder-ful; the Lord is wonderful in high things.
93.5: Thy witnessings be made able to be believed greatly; Lord, holiness be-cometh thine house, into the length of days.

94.1: God is Lord of vengeances; God of vengeance did freely.
94.2: Be thou enhanced that deemest the earth; yield thou yielding to proud men.
94.3: Lord, how long sinners; how long shall sinners have glory?
94.4: They shall tell out, and shall speak wickedness; all men shall speak that work unrightfulness.
94.5: Lord, they have made low thy people; and they have dis-eased thine heritage.
94.6: They killed a widow and a come-ling; and they have slain fatherless children and motherless.
94.7: And they said, The Lord shall not see it; and, God of Jacob shall not understand.
94.8: Ye unwise men in the people, understand; and, ye fools, learn some-time.
94.9: Shall not he hear, that planted the ear; either beholdeth not he, that made the eye?
94.10: Shall not he reprove, that chastiseth folks; shall he not know, which teacheth man knowing?
94.11: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men; that those [[or they]] be vain.
94.12: Blessed is the man, whom thou, Lord, hast learned; and hast taught him of thy law.
94.13: That thou assuage him from evil days; till a ditch be digged to the sinner.
94.14: For the Lord shall not put away his people; and he shall not forsake his heritage.
94.15: Till rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] be turned into doom; and who be nigh it, all that be of rightful heart.
94.16: Who shall rise with me against mis-doers; either who shall stand with me against them that work wickedness?
94.17: No but for the Lord helped me; almost my soul had dwelled in hell.
94.18: If I said, My foot was stirred; Lord, thy mercy helped me.
94.19: After the multitude of my sorrows in mine heart; thy comforts made glad my soul.
94.20: Whether the seat of wickedness cleaveth to thee; that makest travail in commandment?
94.21: They shall take hold against the soul of a just [[or rightwise]] man; and they shall condemn innocent blood.
94.22: And the Lord was made to me into refuge; and my God was made into the help of mine hope.
94.23: And he shall yield to them the wickedness of them; and in the malice of them he shall lose them, our Lord God shall lose them.

95.1: Come ye, make ye full out joy to the Lord; heartily sing we to God, our health.
95.2: Before-occupy we his face in acknowledging; and heartily sing we to him in psalms.
95.3: For God is a great Lord, and a great King above all gods; for the Lord shall not put away his people.
95.4: For all the ends of [[the]] earth be in his hand; and the highness, [[or the heights]], of hills be his.
95.5: For the sea is his, and he made it; and his hands formed the dry land.
95.6: Come ye, praise we, and fall we down before God; weep we before the Lord that made us;
95.7: for he is our Lord God. And we be the people of his pasture; and the sheep of his hand. If ye have heard his voice today;
95.8: do not ye make hard your hearts. As in the stirring to wrath; by the day of temptation in desert.
95.9: Where your fathers tempted me; they proved and saw my works.
95.10: Forty years I was offended to this generation; and I said, Ever[[more]] they err in heart. And these men knew not my ways;
95.11: to whom I swore in mine ire, they shall not enter into my rest.

96.1: Sing ye a new song to the Lord; all earth, sing ye to the Lord.
96.2: Sing ye to the Lord, and bless ye his name; tell ye his health from day into day.
96.3: Tell ye his glory among heathen men; his marvels among all peoples.
96.4: For the Lord is great, and worthy to be praised full much; he is feared-ful above all gods.
96.5: For all the gods of heathen men be fiends; but the Lord made heavens.
96.6: Acknowledging and fairness is in his sight; holiness and worthy doing is in his hallowing.
96.7: Ye countries of heathen men, bring to the Lord, bring ye glory and honour to the Lord;
96.8: bring ye to the Lord glory to his name. Take ye sacrifices, and enter ye into the halls of him;
96.9: praise ye the Lord in his holy hall. All earth be moved of his face;
96.10: say ye among heathen men, that the Lord hath reigned. And he hath amended the world, that shall not be moved; he shall deem peoples in equity.
96.11: Heavens be glad, and the earth make full out joy, the sea and the fullness thereof be moved altogether;
96.12: fields shall make joy, and all things that be in those [[or them]]. Then all the trees of woods shall make full out joy,
96.13: for the face of the Lord, for he cometh; for he cometh to deem the earth. He shall deem the world in equity; and peoples in his truth.

97.1: The Lord hath reigned, the earth make full out joy; many isles be glad.
97.2: Cloud and darkness in his compass; rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] and doom is [[the]] amending [[or correction]] of his seat.
97.3: Fire shall go before him; and shall enflame, either set afire, his enemies in compass.
97.4: His lightnings shined to the world; the earth saw, and was moved.
97.5: Hills as wax floated [[or flowed]] down from the face of the Lord; all earth from the face of the Lord.
97.6: Heavens told his rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]]; and all peoples saw his glory.
97.7: All they that worship graven things, or images, be shamed, and they that have glory in their simu-lacra; all ye angels of the Lord, worship him.
97.8: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah made full out joy, for thy dooms, Lord.
97.9: For thou, Lord, art the highest on all earth; thou art greatly enhanced over all gods.
97.10: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil; the Lord keepeth the souls of his saints; he shall deliver them from the hand of the sinner.
97.11: Light is risen to the rightful [[or rightwise]] man; and gladness to rightful men of heart.
97.12: Just [[or rightwise]] men, be ye glad in the Lord; and acknowledge ye to the mind of his hallowing.

98.1: A psalm. Sing ye a new song to the Lord; for he hath done marvels. His right hand and his holy arm; hath made health to him.
98.2: The Lord hath made known his health; in the sight of heathen men he hath showed his rightfulness [[or right-wiseness]].
98.3: He bethought on his mercy; and on his truth, to the house of Israel. All the ends of earth; saw the health of our God.
98.4: All earth, make ye heartily joy to God; sing ye, and make ye full out joy, and say ye psalm.
98.5: Sing ye to the Lord in an harp, in harp and in voice of psalm;
98.6: in trumps beaten out with hammer, and in voice of a trump of horn. Heartily sing ye in the sight of the Lord, the King;
98.7: the sea and the fullness thereof be moved; the world, and they that dwell therein.
98.8: Floods shall make joy with hand; together hills shall make full out joy,
98.9: for the sight of the Lord; for he cometh to deem the earth. He shall deem the world in rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]]; and peoples in equity.

99.1: The Lord hath reigned, [[the]] peoples be wroth; thou that sittest on cherubim, the earth be moved.
99.2: The Lord is great in Zion; and high above all peoples.
99.3: Acknowledge they to thy great name, for it is fearedful and holy;
99.4: and the honour of the king loveth doom. Thou hast made ready dress-ings [[or rightforth rulings]]; thou hast made doom and rightfulness [[or right-wiseness]] in Jacob.
99.5: Enhance ye our Lord God; and worship ye at the stool of his feet, for it is holy.
99.6: Moses and Aaron were among his priests; and Samuel was among them that inwardly call his name. They inwardly called the Lord, and he heard them;
99.7: in a pillar of cloud he spake to them. They kept his witnessings; and the commandment which he gave to them.
99.8: Our Lord God, thou heardest them; God, thou were merciful to them, and thou tookest vengeance on all their findings.
99.9: Enhance ye our Lord God, and worship ye in his holy hill; for our Lord God is holy.

100.1: A psalm to acknowledge. All earth, sing ye heartily to God;
100.2: serve ye the Lord in gladness. Enter ye in his sight in full out joying.
100.3: Know ye, that the Lord himself is God; he made us, and not we made us. His people, and the sheep of his pasture,
100.4: enter ye into his gates in acknowl-edging; enter ye into his porches, acknowledge ye to him in hymns. Praise ye his name,
100.5: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy is without end; and his truth is in generation and into generation.

101.1: The psalm of David. Lord, I shall sing to thee; mercy and doom. I shall sing,
101.2: and I shall understand in a way without wem; when thou shalt come to me. I went perfectly in the inno-cence of mine heart; in the middle of mine house.
101.3: I setted not forth before mine eyes an unjust thing; I hated them that made trespassings.
101.4: A shrewd heart cleaved not to me; I knew not a wicked man bowing away from me.
101.5: I pursued him that backbited privily his neighbour. With the proud eye and an heart unable to be filled; I ate not with this.
101.6: Mine eyes were to the faithful men of earth, that they sit with me; he that went in a way without wem, ministered [[or served]] to me.
101.7: He that doeth pride, shall not dwell in the middle of mine house; he that speaketh wicked things, served not in the sight of mine eyes.
101.8: In the morrowtide I killed all the sinners of earth; that I should lose from the city of the Lord all men working wickedness.

102.1: The prayer of a poor man, when he was anguished, and shedded out his speech before the Lord. Lord, hear thou my prayer; and my cry come to thee.
102.2: Turn not away thy face from me; in whatever day I am troubled, bow down thine ear to me. In whatever day I shall inwardly call thee; hear thou me swiftly.
102.3: For my days have failed as smoke; and my bones have dried up as croutons or cracklings, either leavings of frying.
102.4: I am smitten as hay, and mine heart dried up; for I have forgotten to eat my bread.
102.5: Of the voice of my wailing; my bone cleaved to my flesh.
102.6: I am made like a pelican of wilderness; I am made as a night crow in an house.
102.7: I waked; and I am made as a solitary sparrow in the roof.
102.8: All day mine enemies despised me; and they that praised me swore against me.
102.9: For I ate ashes as bread; and I meddled [[or mingled]] my drink with weeping.
102.10: From the face of the ire of thine indignation; for thou raising me [[up]] hast hurtled me down.
102.11: My days bowed away as a shadow; and I waxed dry as hay.
102.12: But, Lord, thou dwellest without end; and thy memorial in generation and into generation.
102.13: Lord, thou rising up, shalt have mercy on Zion; for the time to have mercy thereof cometh, for the time cometh.
102.14: For the stones thereof pleased thy servants; and they shall have mercy on the land thereof.
102.15: And, Lord, heathen men shall dread thy name; and all kings of earth shall dread thy glory.
102.16: For the Lord hath built [[up]] Zion; and he shall be seen in his glory.
102.17: He beheld on the prayer of meek men; and he despised not the prayer of them.
102.18: Be these things written in another generation; and the people that shall be made shall praise the Lord.
102.19: For he beheld from his high holy place; the Lord looked from heaven into earth.
102.20: For to hear the wailings of fettered men; and for to unbind the sons of slain men.
102.21: That they tell in Zion the name of the Lord; and his praising in Jerusalem.
102.22: In gathering together peoples into one; and kings, that they serve the Lord.
102.23: It answered to him in the way of his virtue; Tell thou to me the few-ness of my days.
102.24: Again-call thou not me in the middle of my days; thy years be in generation and into generation.
102.25: Lord, thou foundedest the earth in the beginning; and heavens be the works of thine hands.
102.26: Those shall perish, but thou dwellest perfectly; and all shall wax eld [[or old]] as a cloth. And thou shalt change them as a covering, and those shall be changed;
102.27: but thou art the same thyself, and thy years shall not fail.
102.28: The sons of thy servants shall dwell; and the seed of them shall be dressed into the world.

103.1: A psalm of David. My soul, bless thou the Lord, and all things that be within me, bless his holy name.
103.2: My soul, bless thou the Lord; and do not thou forget all the yieldings of him.
103.3: Which doeth mercy to all thy wickednesses; which healeth all thy sicknesses.
103.4: Which again-buyeth thy life from death; which crowneth thee in mercy and merciful doings.
103.5: Which [[ful]] filleth thy desire in goods; thy youth shall be renewed as the youth of an eagle.
103.6: The Lord doing mercies; and doom, to all men suffering wrong.
103.7: He made his ways known to Moses; his wills or deeds to the sons of Israel.
103.8: The Lord is a merciful doer, and merciful in will; long abiding, and much merciful.
103.9: He shall not be wroth without end; and he shall not threaten without end.
103.10: He did not to us after our sins; neither he yielded to us after our wickednesses.
103.11: For by the highness of heaven from earth; he made strong his mercy on men dreading him.
103.12: As much as the east is from the west; he made [[a]] far our wicked-nesses from us.
103.13: As a father hath mercy on his sons, the Lord had mercy on men dreading him;
103.14: for he knew our making. He bethought that we be dust,
103.15: a man is as hay; his day[[s]] shall flower out so as a flower of the field.
103.16: For the spirit shall pass in him, and it shall not abide; and it shall no more know his place.
103.17: But the mercy of the Lord is from without beginning, and till into with-out end; on men dreading him. And his rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] is into the sons of sons;
103.18: to them that keep his testament. And be mindful of his command-ments; to do those [[or them]].
103.19: The Lord hath made ready his seat in heaven; and his realm shall be lord of all.
103.20: Angels of the Lord, bless ye the Lord; ye mighty in virtue, doing his word, to hear the voice of his words.
103.21: All virtues or hosts of the Lord, bless ye the Lord; ye ministers of him, that do his will.
103.22: All works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, in each place of his lord-ship; my soul, bless thou the Lord.

104.1: My soul, bless thou the Lord; my Lord God, thou art magnified greatly. Thou hast clothed acknowledging and fairness;
104.2: and thou art clothed with light, as with a cloth. And thou stretchest forth heaven as a skin;
104.3: and thou coverest with waters the higher parts thereof. Which settest a cloud thy ascending; which goest on the feathers of winds.
104.4: Which makest spirits thine angels; and thy ministers a burning fire.
104.5: Which hast founded the earth on his stableness; it shall not be bowed into the world of world.
104.6: The depth of waters as a cloth is the clothing thereof; waters shall stand on hills.
104.7: Those [[or they]] shall flee from thy blaming; men shall be afeared of the voice of thy thunder.
104.8: Hills go up, and fields go down; into the place which thou hast founded to those [[or them]].
104.9: Thou hast set a term, which they shall not pass; neither those [[or they]] shall be turned, for to cover the earth.
104.10: And thou sendest out wells into great valleys; waters shall pass betwixt the midst of hills.
104.11: All the beasts of the field shall drink; wild asses shall abide in their thirst, that is, to be filled in their thirst.
104.12: [[The]] Birds of the air shall dwell on those; from the midst of the stones they shall give voices.
104.13: And thou moistest [[the]] hills of their higher things; the earth shall be [[ful]] filled of the fruit of thy works.
104.14: And thou bringest forth hay to beasts; and herb to the service of men. That thou bring forth bread of the earth;
104.15: and that wine make glad the heart of men. That he make glad the face with oil; and that bread make steadfast the heart of man.
104.16: The trees of the field shall be [[full-]]filled, and the cedars of the Lebanon, which he planted;
104.17: sparrows shall make nest there. The house of the gyrfalcon is the leader of those [[or them]];
104.18: high hills be refuge to harts; the stone is refuge to urchins.
104.19: He made the moon into times; the sun knew his going down.
104.20: Thou hast set darknesses, and night is made; all beasts of the wood shall go therein.
104.21: Lions’ whelps roaring for to ravish; and to seek of God meat to them-selves.
104.22: The sun is risen, and those [[or they]] be gathered together; and those [[or they]] shall be set in their couches.
104.23: A man shall go out to his work; and to his working, till to the eventide.
104.24: Lord, thy works be magnified full much, thou hast made all things in wisdom; the earth is filled with thy possessions.
104.25: This sea is great and large to hands; there be creeping beasts, of which is no number. Little beasts with [[the]] great;
104.26: ships shall pass there. This dragon which thou hast formed, for to scorn him.
104.27: All things abide of thee; that thou give to them meat in time.
104.28: When thou shalt give to them, they shall gather; when thou shalt open thine hand, all things shall be filled with goodness.
104.29: But when thou shalt turn away thy face, they shall be troubled; thou shalt take away the spirit of them, and they shall fail; and they shall turn again into their dust.
104.30: Send out thy spirit, and they shall be formed of the new or reformed of new; and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.
104.31: The glory of the Lord be into the world; the Lord shall be glad in his works.
104.32: Which beholdeth the earth, and maketh it to tremble; which toucheth hills, and those [[or they]] smoke.
104.33: I shall sing to the Lord in my life; I shall say psalm to my God, as long as I am.
104.34: My speech be merry or mirth to him; forsooth I shall delight in the Lord.
104.35: Sinners fail from the earth, and wicked men fail, so that they be not; my soul, bless thou the Lord.

105.1: Alleluia. Acknowledge ye to the Lord, and inwardly call ye his name; tell ye his works among heathen men.
105.2: Sing ye to him, and say ye psalm to him, and tell ye all his marvels;
105.3: be ye praised in his holy name. The heart of men seeking the Lord be glad;
105.4: seek ye the Lord, and be ye con-firmed; seek ye ever[[more]] his face.
105.5: Have ye mind on his marvels, which he did; on his great wonders, and dooms of his mouth.
105.6: The seed of Abraham, his servant; the sons of Jacob, his chosen man.
105.7: He is our Lord God; his dooms be in all the earth.
105.8: He was mindful of his testament into the world; of the word which he commanded into a thousand gener-ations.
105.9: Which he disposed to Abraham; and of his oath to Isaac.
105.10: And he ordained it to Jacob into a commandment; and to Israel into everlasting testament.
105.11: And he said, I shall give to thee the land of Canaan; the cord of your heritage.
105.12: When they were in a little number; and the comelings of them were full few.
105.13: And they passed from folk into folk; and from a realm into another people.
105.14: He left not a man to annoy them; and he chastised kings for them.
105.15: Saying, Do not ye touch my christs; and do not ye do wickedly among my prophets.
105.16: And God called hunger on earth; and he wasted all the steadfastness of bread.
105.17: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold into a servant.
105.18: They made low his feet in fetters, iron passed by [[or through]] his soul;
105.19: till the word of him came. The speech of the Lord enflamed him;
105.20: the king sent and unbound him; the prince of peoples sent and delivered him.
105.21: He ordained him lord of his house; and prince of all his possessions.
105.22: That he should learn [[or teach]] his princes as himself; and that he should teach his eld [[or old]] men prudence.
105.23: And Israel entered into Egypt; and Jacob was a comeling in the land of Ham.
105.24: And God increased his people greatly; and made them steadfast on his enemies.
105.25: He turned the heart of them, that they hated his people; and did guile [[or treachery]] against his servants.
105.26: He sent Moses, his servant; [[and]] that Aaron, whom he chose.
105.27: He putted [[or put]] in them to tell and to do the words of his miracles; and of his great wonders in the land of Ham.
105.28: He sent darknesses, and made it dark; and he made not bitter his words.
105.29: He turned the waters of them into blood; and he killed the fishes of them.
105.30: And the land of them gave pad-docks; in the privy places of the kings of them.
105.31: God said, and a flesh fly [[or hound flea]] came; and gnats in all the coasts of them.
105.32: He setted [[or put]] their rains into hail; fire burning in the land of them.
105.33: And he smote the vines of them, and the fig trees of them; and all-brake the trees of the coasts of them.
105.34: He said, and the locust came; and a bruchus of which there was no number.
105.35: And it ate all the hay in the land of them; and it ate all the fruit of the land of them.
105.36: And he killed each the first engen-dered thing in the land of them; the first fruits of all the travail of them.
105.37: And he led out them with silver and gold; and none was sick in the lineages of them.
105.38: Egypt was glad in the going out of them; for the dread of them lay on Egyptians.
105.39: He spreaded abroad a cloud, into the covering of them; and fire, that it shined to them by night.
105.40: They asked, and a curlew came; and he [[ful]] filled them with the bread of heaven.
105.41: He brake the stone, and waters flowed; floods went forth in the dry place.
105.42: For he was mindful of his holy word; which he had to Abraham, his servant.
105.43: And he led out his people in full out joying; and his chosen men in gladness.
105.44: And he gave to them the countries of heathen men; and they had in possession the travails of peoples.
105.45: That they keep his justifyings; and keep his law.

106.1: Alleluia. Acknowledge ye to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy is without end.
106.2: Who shall speak of the powers of the Lord; shall make known all his praisings?
106.3: Blessed be they that keep doom; and do rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] in all time.
106.4: Lord, have thou mind on us, in the good pleasance of thy people; visit thou us in thine health.
106.5: To see in the goodness of thy chosen men, to be glad in the gladness of thy folk; that thou be praised with thine heritage.
106.6: We have sinned with our fathers; we have done unjustly, we have done wickedness.
106.7: Our fathers in Egypt understood not thy marvels; they were not mindful of the multitude of thy mercy. And they going into the sea, into the Red Sea, stirred him to wrath;
106.8: and he saved them for his name, that he should make known his power.
106.9: And he parted the Red Sea, and it was dried; and he led forth them in the depths of waters, as in desert.
106.10: And he saved them from the hand of haters; and he again-bought them from the hand of the enemy.
106.11: And the waters covered men troubling them; one of them abode not.
106.12: And they believed to his words; and they praised the praising of him.
106.13: They had soon done, they forgat his works; and they abided not his counsel.
106.14: And they coveted covetousness in desert; and tempted God in a place without water.
106.15: And he gave to them the asking of them; and he sent fullness into the souls of them.
106.16: And they wrathed Moses in the castles [[or tents]]; Aaron, the holy man of the Lord.
106.17: The earth was opened, and swal-lowed [[down]] Dathan; and covered on the congregation of Abiram.
106.18: And fire burnt on high in the synagogue of them; flame burnt [[the]] sinners.
106.19: And they made a calf in Horeb; and worshipped a molten image.
106.20: And they exchanged their glory; into the likeness of a calf eating hay.
106.21: They forgat God, that saved them, that did great works in Egypt,
106.22: marvels in the land of Ham; fearedful things in the Red Sea.
106.23: And God said, that he would lose them; and he would have, if Moses, his chosen man, had not stood in the breaking of his sight. That he should turn away his ire; lest he lost them.
106.24: And they had the desirable land for nought, for they believed not to his word,
106.25: and they grutched in their taber-nacles; they heard not the voice of the Lord.
106.26: And he raised his hand on them; to cast down them in desert.
106.27: And to cast away their seed in nations; and to lose them in countries.
106.28: And they made sacrifice to Baal-peor; and they ate the sacrifices of dead beasts.
106.29: And they wrathed God in their findings; and falling, either death, was multiplied in them.
106.30: And Phinehas stood, and pleased God; and the vengeance ceased.
106.31: And it was areckoned to him to rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]]; in gen-eration and into generation, till into without end.
106.32: And they wrathed God at the waters of against-saying; and Moses was travailed for them, that is, troubled in soul,
106.33: for they made bitter his spirit, and he parted [[or ordained]] in his lips.
106.34: They lost not [[the]] heathen men; which the Lord said to them to do.
106.35: And they were meddled [[or mingled]] among heathen men, and learned the works of them;
106.36: and served the graven images of them; and it was made to them into cause of stumbling.
106.37: And they offered their sons, and their daughters, to fiends.
106.38: And they shedded out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters; which they sacrificed to the graven images of Canaan. And the earth was slain in bloods,
106.39: and was defouled in the works of them; and they did fornication in their findings.
106.40: And the Lord was wroth by strong vengeance against his people; and he had abomination of his heritage.
106.41: And he betook them into the hands of heathen men; and they that hated them, were lords of them.
106.42: And their enemies did tribulation to them, and they were meeked under the hands of enemies;
106.43: oft he delivered them. But they wrathed him in their counsel; and they were made low in their wicked-nesses.
106.44: And he saw, when they were set in tribulation; and he heard the prayer of them.
106.45: And he was mindful of his testa-ment; and it repented him by the multitude of his mercy.
106.46: And he gave them into mercies; in the sight of all men, that had taken them.
106.47: Our Lord God, make thou us safe; and gather together us from nations. That we acknowledge to thine holy name; and have glory in thy praising.
106.48: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from the world and till into the world; and all the people shall say, Be it done, be it done.

107.1: Alleluia. Acknowledge ye to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy is into the world.
107.2: Say they, that be again-bought of the Lord; which he again-bought from the hand of the enemy,
107.3: from countries he gathered them together. From the rising of the sun, and from the going down; from the north, and from the sea.
107.4: They erred in wilderness, in a place without water; they found not way of the city of dwelling place.
107.5: They were hungry and thirsty; their souls failed in them.
107.6: And they cried to the Lord, when they were set in tribulation; and he delivered them from their needinesses.
107.7: And he led forth them into the right way; that they should go into the city of dwelling.
107.8: The mercies of the Lord, acknowl-edge to him; and his marvels acknowl-edge to the sons of men.
107.9: For he [[ful]] filled a void man; and he filled with goods an hungry man.
107.10: God delivered men sitting in dark-ness, and in the shadow of death; and men imprisoned in beggary, and in irons.
107.11: For they made bitter the speeches of God; and wrathed the counsel of the Highest.
107.12: And the heart of them was made meek in travails; and they were sick, and none was that helped.
107.13: And they cried to the Lord, when they were set in tribulation; and he delivered them from their needinesses.
107.14: And he led them out of dark-nesses, and [[the]] shadow of death; and brake the bonds of them.
107.15: The mercies of the Lord, ac-knowledge to him; and his marvels, acknowledge to the sons of men.
107.16: For he all-brake [[the]] brazen gates; and he brake [[the]] iron bars.
107.17: He up-took them from the way of their wickedness; for they were made low for their unrightfulnesses.
107.18: The soul of them loathed all meat; and they nighed unto the gates of death.
107.19: And they cried to the Lord, when they were set in tribulation; and he delivered them from their needinesses.
107.20: He sent his word, and healed them; and delivered them from the perishings of them.
107.21: The mercies of the Lord, ac-knowledge to him; and his marvels to the sons of men.
107.22: And offer they the sacrifice of praising; and tell they his works with full out joying.
107.23: They that go down into the sea in ships; and make working in many waters.
107.24: They saw the works of the Lord; and his marvels in the depth.
107.25: He said, and the spirit of tempest stood; and the waves thereof were areared.
107.26: They ascend [[or go up]] till to heavens, and go down unto the depths; the soul of them failed in evils.
107.27: They were troubled, and they were moved as a drunken man; and all the wisdom of them was devoured.
107.28: And they cried to the Lord, when they were set in tribulation; and he led them out of their needinesses.
107.29: And he ordained the tempest there-of into a soft wind, either peaceability; and the waves thereof were stilled.
107.30: And they were glad, for those [[or they]] were still; and he led them forth into the haven of their will.
107.31: The mercies of the Lord, acknowl-edge to him; and his marvels to the sons of men.
107.32: And enhance they him in the church of the people; and praise they him in the chairs of the elder men.
107.33: He hath set floods into desert; and the outgoings of waters into thirsty ground.
107.34: He hath set fruitful land into salti-ness; for the malice of men dwelling therein.
107.35: He hath set desert into ponds of waters; and [[the]] earth without water into [[the]] outgoings of waters.
107.36: And he set there hungry men; and they made a city of dwelling.
107.37: And they sowed fields, and planted vines; and made fruit of birth.
107.38: And he blessed them, and they were multiplied greatly; and he made not less their work beasts.
107.39: And they were made few; and were travailed of tribulation of evils and of sorrow.
107.40: Strife was shed [[or poured]] out on princes; and he made them for to err without the way, and not in the way.
107.41: And he helped the poor man from poverty; and setted [[or put]] families as a sheep bringing forth lambs.
107.42: Rightful men shall see, and shall be glad; and all wickedness shall stop his mouth.
107.43: Who is wise, and shall keep these things; and shall understand the mercies of the Lord?

108.1: The song of the psalm of David. Mine heart is ready, God, mine heart is ready; I shall sing, and I shall say psalm in my glory.
108.2: My glory, rise thou up, psaltery and harp, rise thou up; I shall rise up early.
108.3: Lord, I shall acknowledge to thee among peoples; and I shall say psalm to thee among nations.
108.4: For why, God, thy mercy is great on heavens; and thy truth is till to the clouds.
108.5: God, be thou enhanced above heavens; and thy glory over all earth.
108.6: That thy darlings be delivered, make thou safe with thy right hand, and hear [[thou]] me;
108.7: God spake in his holy place. I shall make full out joy, and I shall part Shechem; and I shall mete [[or measure]] the great valley of tabernacles.
108.8: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; and Ephraim is the up-taking of mine head. Judah is my king;
108.9: Moab is the cauldron of mine hope. Into Idumea I shall stretch forth my shoe; aliens be made friends to me.
108.10: Who shall lead me forth into a strong city; who shall lead me forth till into Idumea?
108.11: Whether not thou, God, that hast put us away; and, God, shalt thou not go out in our virtues or hosts?
108.12: Give thou help to us out of tribulation; for the help of man is vain.
108.13: We shall make virtue in God; and he shall bring our enemies to nought.

109.1: To victory, the psalm of David. God, hold thou not still my praising;
109.2: for the mouth of the sinner, and the mouth of the guileful man, is opened on me. They spake against me with a guileful [[or treacherous]] tongue,
109.3: and they encompassed me with words of hatred; and fought against me without cause.
109.4: For that thing that they should love me, they backbited me; but I prayed for them.
109.5: And they setted against me evils for goods; and hatred for my love.
109.6: Ordain thou a sinner on him; and the devil stand on his right half.
109.7: When he is deemed, go he out condemned; and his prayer be made into sin.
109.8: His days be made few; and another take his bishopric.
109.9: His sons be made fatherless; and his wife a widow.
109.10: His sons trembling be borne over, and beg; and be they cast out of their habitations.
109.11: An usurer seek all his chattel; and aliens ravish his travails.
109.12: None helper be to him; neither any be that have mercy on his motherless children.
109.13: His sons be made into perishing; the name of him be done away in one generation.
109.14: The wickedness of his fathers come again into mind in the sight of the Lord; and the sin of his mother be not done away.
109.15: Be they made ever[[more]] against the Lord; and the mind of them perish from earth.
109.16: For that thing that he thought not to do mercy, and he pursued a poor man and a beggar; and to slay a man compunct in heart.
109.17: And he loved cursing, and it shall come to him; and he would not give blessing, and it shall be made far from him.
109.18: And he clothed cursing as a cloth, and it entered as water into his inner things; and as oil in his bones.
109.19: Be it made to him as a cloth, with which he is covered; and as a girdle, with which he is ever[[more]] girded.
109.20: This is the work of them that back-bite me with the Lord; and that speak evils against my life.
109.21: And thou, Lord God, do with me for thy name; for thy mercy is sweet. Deliver thou me,
109.22: for I am needy and poor; and mine heart is troubled within me.
109.23: I am taken away as a shadow, when it boweth away; and I am shaken away as locusts.
109.24: My knees be made feeble with fasting; and my flesh was changed for oil.
109.25: And I am made a shame to them; they saw me, and moved their heads.
109.26: My Lord God, help thou me; make thou me safe by thy mercy.
109.27: And they shall know, that this is thine hand; and thou, Lord, hast done it.
109.28: And they shall curse, and thou shalt bless, they that rise against me, be shamed; but thy servant shall be glad.
109.29: They that backbite me, be clothed with shame; and be they covered with their shame, as with a double cloth.
109.30: I shall acknowledge to the Lord greatly with my mouth; and I shall praise him in the middle of many men.
109.31: Which stood nigh on the right half of a poor man; to make safe my soul from pursuers.

110.1: The psalm of David. The Lord said to my Lord; Sit thou on my right side. Till I put thine enemies a stool of thy feet.
110.2: The Lord shall send out from Zion the rod of thy virtue; be thou lord in the midst of thine enemies.
110.3: The beginning is with thee in the day of thy virtue, in the brightnesses of saints; I begat thee of the womb, before the day star.
110.4: The Lord swore, and it shall not repent him; Thou art a priest without end, by the order of Melchizedek.
110.5: The Lord on thy right side; hath broken kings in the day of his venge-ance.
110.6: He shall deem among nations, he shall fill the land with fallings; he shall shake heads in the land of many men.
110.7: He drank of the strand [[or stream]] in the way; therefore he enhanced the head.

111.1: Alleluia. Lord, I shall acknowledge to thee in all mine heart; in the council, and congregation of just men.
111.2: The works of the Lord be great; sought out into all his wills.
111.3: His work is acknowledging and great doing; and his rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] dwelleth into the world of world.
111.4: The Lord, merciful in will, and a merciful doer, hath made a mind of his marvels;
111.5: he hath given meat to men dreading him. He shall be mindful of his testament into the world;
111.6: he shall tell to his people the strength of his works. That he give to them the heritage of folks;
111.7: the works of his hands be truth and doom. All his commandments be faithful,
111.8: confirmed into the world of world; made in truth and equity.
111.9: The Lord sent redemption to his people; he commanded his testament without end. His name is holy and dreadful;
111.10: the beginning of wisdom is the dread of the Lord. Good understanding is to all that do it; his praising dwelleth into the world of world.

112.1: Alleluia. Blessed is the man that dreadeth the Lord; he shall delight full much in his commandments.
112.2: His seed shall be mighty in [[the]] earth; the generation of rightful [[or right]] men shall be blessed.
112.3: Glory and riches be in his house; and his rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] dwelleth into the world of world.
112.4: Light is risen up in darknesses to rightful [[or right]] men; the Lord is merciful in will, and a merciful doer, and rightful [[or rightwise]].
112.5: The man is merry, that doeth mercy, and lendeth; he disposeth his words in doom;
112.6: for he shall not be moved without end. A just [[or rightwise]] man shall be in everlasting mind;
112.7: he shall not dread of an evil hearing. His heart is ready for to hope in the Lord;
112.8: his heart is confirmed, he shall not be moved, till he despise his enemies.
112.9: He spreaded abroad, he gave to poor men; his rightwiseness dwelleth into the world of world; his horn shall be raised in glory.
112.10: A sinner shall see, and shall be wroth; he shall gnash with his teeth, and shall fail, either shall wax rotten; the desire of sinners shall perish.

113.1: Alleluia. Servants, praise ye the Lord; praise ye the name of the Lord.
113.2: The name of the Lord be blessed; from this time now, and till into the world.
113.3: From the rising of the sun till to the going down; the name of the Lord is worthy to be praised.
113.4: The Lord is high above all folks; and his glory is above heavens.
113.5: Who is as our Lord God, that dwelleth in high things;
113.6: and beholdeth meek things in heaven and in earth?
113.7: Raising a needy man from the earth; and enhancing a poor man from drit.
113.8: That he set him with princes; with the princes of his people.
113.9: Which maketh a barren woman dwell in the house; a glad mother of sons.

114.1: Alleluia. In the going out of Israel from Egypt; of the house of Jacob from the heathen people.
114.2: Judah was made the hallowing of him; Israel the power of him.
114.3: The sea saw, and fled; Jordan was turned aback.
114.4: Mountains full out joyed as rams; and little hills as the lambs of sheep.
114.5: Thou sea, what was to thee, for thou fleddest; and thou, Jordan, for thou were turned aback?
114.6: Mountains, ye made full out joy as rams; and little hills, as the lambs of sheep.
114.7: The earth was moved from the face of the Lord; from the face of God of Jacob.
114.8: Which turned a stone into a pond of waters; and an hard rock into wells of waters.

115.1: Alleluia. Lord, not to us, Lord, not to us; but give thou glory to thy name. Of thy mercy, and of thy truth;
115.2: lest any time heathen men say, Where is the God of them?
115.3: Forsooth our God in heaven; did all things, whichever he would.
115.4: The simulacra of heathen men be silver and gold; the works of men’s hands.
115.5: They have mouths, and shall not speak; they have eyes, and shall not see.
115.6: They have ears, and shall not hear; they have nostrils, and shall not smell.
115.7: They have hands, and shall not grope; they have feet, and shall not go; they shall not cry in their throat.
115.8: They that make those simulacra be made like those [[or them]]; and all that trust in them.
115.9: The house of Israel hoped in the Lord; he is the helper of them, and the defender of them.
115.10: The house of Aaron hoped in the Lord; he is the helper of them, and the defender of them.
115.11: They that dread the Lord, hoped in the Lord; he is the helper of them, and the defender of them.
115.12: The Lord was mindful of us; and blessed us. He blessed the house of Israel; he blessed the house of Aaron.
115.13: He blessed all men that dread the Lord; both little and greater.
115.14: The Lord add, either increase, on you; on you, and on your sons.
115.15: Blessed be ye of the Lord; that made heaven and earth.
115.16: Heaven of heaven is to the Lord/ Heaven of heavens to the Lord; but he gave the earth to the sons of men.
115.17: Lord, not dead men shall praise thee; neither all men that go down into hell.
115.18: But we that live, bless the Lord; from this time now, and till into the world.

116.1: Alleluia. I loved the Lord; for the Lord shall hear the voice of my prayer.
116.2: For he bowed down his ear to me; and I shall inwardly call him in my days.
116.3: The sorrows of death encompass-ed me; and the perils of hell found me. I found tribulation and sorrow;
116.4: and I called inwardly the name of the Lord. Thou, Lord, deliver my soul;
116.5: the Lord is merciful, and just [[or rightwise]]; and our God doeth mercy.
116.6: And the Lord keepeth little children; I was meeked, and he delivered me.
116.7: My soul, turn thou into thy rest; for the Lord hath done well to thee.
116.8: For he hath delivered my soul from death; mine eyes from weepings, and my feet from falling down.
116.9: I shall please the Lord; in the country of them that live.
116.10: I believed, for which thing I spake; forsooth I was made low full much.
116.11: I said in my passing; Each man is a liar.
116.12: What shall I yield to the Lord; for all things which he hath yielded to me?
116.13: I shall take the cup of health; and I shall inwardly call the name of the Lord.
116.14: I shall yield my vows to the Lord before all his people;
116.15: the death of saints of the Lord is precious in his sight.
116.16: O! Lord, for I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid. Thou hast broken my bonds,
116.17: to thee I shall offer a sacrifice of praising; and I shall inwardly call the name of the Lord.
116.18: I shall yield my vows to the Lord, in the sight of all his people;
116.19: in the foreyards of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, Jerusalem.

117.1: Alleluia. All heathen men, praise ye the Lord; all peoples, praise ye him.
117.2: For his mercy is confirmed on us; and the truth of the Lord dwelleth without end.

118.1: Alleluia. Acknowledge ye to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy is without end.
118.2: Israel say now, for he is good; for his mercy is without end.
118.3: The house of Aaron say now; for his mercy is without end.
118.4: They that dread the Lord, say now; for his mercy is without end.
118.5: Out Of tribulation I inwardly called the Lord; and the Lord heard me in largeness.
118.6: The Lord is an helper to me; I shall not dread what man shall do to me.
118.7: The Lord is an helper to me; and I shall despise mine enemies.
118.8: It is better to trust in the Lord; than for to trust in man.
118.9: It is better for to hope in the Lord; than to hope in princes.
118.10: All folks encompassed me; and in the name of the Lord it befelled, for I am avenged on them.
118.11: They compassing encompassed me; and in the name of the Lord, for I am avenged on them.
118.12: They encompassed me as bees, and they burnt out as fire among thorns; and in the name of the Lord, for I am avenged on them.
118.13: I was hurled, and turned upside-down, that I should fall down; and the Lord took me up.
118.14: The Lord is my strength, and my praising; and he is made to me into health.
118.15: The voice of full out joying and of health; be in the tabernacles of just [[or rightwise]] men. The right hand of the Lord hath done virtue,
118.16: the right hand of the Lord en-hanced me; the right hand of the Lord hath done virtue.
118.17: I shall not die, but I shall live; and I shall tell the works of the Lord.
118.18: The Lord chastising hath chastised me; and he gave not me to death.
118.19: Open ye to me the gates of rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]], and I shall enter by those [[or them]], and I shall acknowledge to the Lord;
118.20: this gate is of the Lord, and just [[or rightwise]] men shall enter by it.
118.21: I shall acknowledge to thee, for thou heardest me; and art made to me into health.
118.22: The stone which the builders reproved; this is made into the head of the corner.
118.23: This thing is made of the Lord; and it is wonderful before our eyes.
118.24: This is the day which the Lord made; make we full out joy, and be we glad therein.
118.25: O! Lord, make thou me safe, O! Lord, make thou well prosperity;
118.26: blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord. We blessed you of the house of the Lord;
118.27: God is Lord, and he hath given light to us. Ordain ye a solemn day in thick peoples; till to the horns of the altar.
118.28: Thou art my God, and I shall acknowledge to thee; thou art my God, and I shall enhance thee. I shall acknowledge to thee, for thou heardest me; and thou art made to me into health.
118.29: Acknowledge ye to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy is without end.

119.1: Alleluia. [[Aleph.]] Blessed be men without wem in the way; that go in the law of the Lord.
119.2: Blessed be they, that seek his wit-nessings; and seek him in all the heart.
119.3: For they that work wickedness; went not in his ways.
119.4: Thou hast commanded; that thy behests be kept greatly.
119.5: I would that my ways were dressed; to keep thy justifyings.
119.6: Then I shall not be shamed; when I shall behold perfectly in all thy behests.
119.7: I shall acknowledge to thee in the dressing [[or right ruling]] of mine heart; in that that I learned the dooms of thy rightfulnesses [[or rightwiseness]].
119.8: I shall keep thy justifyings; forsake thou not me on each side.
119.9: [[Beth.]] In what thing amendeth a young waxing man his way? in keep-ing thy words.
119.10: In all mine heart I sought thee; put thou me not away from thy behests.
119.11: In mine heart I hid thy speeches; that I do not sin against thee.
119.12: Lord, thou art blessed; teach thou me thy justifyings.
119.13: In my lips I have pronounced; all the dooms of thy mouth.
119.14: I delighted in the way of thy witnessings; as in all riches.
119.15: I shall be exercised, either busily occupied, in thy behests; and I shall behold thy ways.
119.16: I shall bethink in thy justifyings; I shall not forget thy words.
119.17: [[Gimel.]] Yield to thy servant; quicken thou me, and I shall keep thy words.
119.18: Lighten thou mine eyes; and I shall behold the marvels of thy law.
119.19: I am a comeling in earth; hide thou not thy behests from me.
119.20: My soul coveted to desire thy justifyings; in all time.
119.21: Thou blamedest the proud; they be cursed, that bow away from thy behests.
119.22: Do thou away from me shame and despising; for I sought thy witnessings.
119.23: For why princes sat, and spake against me; but thy servant was exercised in thy justifyings.
119.24: For why and thy witnessings is my thinking; and my counsel is thy justifyings.
119.25: [[Daleth.]] My soul cleaved to the pavement; quicken thou me by thy word.
119.26: I told out my ways, and thou heardest me; teach thou me thy justifyings.
119.27: Learn [[or Inform]] thou me the way of thy justifyings; and I shall be exercised in thy marvels.
119.28: My soul napped for annoyance; confirm thou me in thy words.
119.29: Remove thou from me the way of wickedness; and in thy law have thou mercy on me.
119.30: I chose the way of truth; I forgat not thy dooms.
119.31: Lord, I cleaved to thy witnessings; do not thou shame me.
119.32: I ran the way of thy command-ments; when thou alargedest mine heart.
119.33: [[He.]] Lord, set thou to me a law, the way of thy justifyings; and I shall seek it ever[[more]].
119.34: Give thou understanding to me, and I shall seek thy law; and I shall keep it in all mine heart.
119.35: Lead me forth in the path of thy behests; for I would or delight in it.
119.36: Bow down mine heart into thy witnessings; and not into avarice.
119.37: Turn thou away mine eyes, that they see not vanity; quicken thou me in thy way.
119.38: Ordain thy speech to thy servant; in thy dread.
119.39: Cut away my shame, which I supposed; for thy dooms be merry.
119.40: Lo! I coveted thy commandments; quicken thou me in thine equity.
119.41: [[Vau.]] And, Lord, thy mercy come [[up]] on me; thine health come by thy speech.
119.42: And I shall answer a word to men saying shame to me; for I hoped in thy words.
119.43: And take thou not away from my mouth the word of truth utterly; for I hoped above in thy dooms.
119.44: And I shall keep thy law ever-[[more]]; into the world, and into the world of world.
119.45: And I went in largeness; for I sought thy commandments.
119.46: And I spake of thy witnessings in the sight of kings; and I was not shamed.
119.47: And I bethought in thy behests; which I loved.
119.48: And I raised mine hands to thy commandments, which I loved; and I shall be exercised in thy justifyings.
119.49: [[Zain.]] Lord, have thou mind on thy word to thy servant; in which word thou hast given hope to me.
119.50: This comforted me in my lowness; for thy word quickened me.
119.51: Proud men did wickedly to me by all things; but I bowed not away from thy law.
119.52: Lord, I was mindful of thy dooms from the world; and I was comforted.
119.53: Failing held me; for sinners for-saking thy law.
119.54: Thy justifyings were delightable to me to be sung; in the place of my pilgrimage.
119.55: Lord, I had mind of thy name by night; and I kept thy law.
119.56: This thing was made to me; for I sought thy justifyings.
119.57: [[Cheth.]] Lord, my part; I said to keep thy law.
119.58: I besought thy face in all mine heart; have thou mercy on me by thy speech.
119.59: I bethought on my ways; and I turned my feet into thy witnessings.
119.60: I am ready, and I am not troubled; to keep thy commandments.
119.61: The cords of sinners have em-braced me; and I have not forgotten thy law.
119.62: At midnight, I rose to acknowl-edge to thee; on the dooms of thy justifyings.
119.63: I am partner of all that dread thee; and keep thy behests.
119.64: Lord, the earth is full of thy mercy; teach thou me thy justifyings.
119.65: [[Teth.]] Lord, thou hast done good-ness with thy servant; by thy word.
119.66: Teach thou me goodness, and lore, either chastising, and knowing; for I believed to thy behests.
119.67: Before that I was made meek, I trespassed; therefore I kept thy speech.
119.68: Thou art good; and in thy good-ness teach thou me thy justifyings.
119.69: The wickedness of them that be proud, is multiplied on me; but in all mine heart I shall seek thy behests.
119.70: The heart of them is crudded, either made hard, as milk; but I be-thought on thy law.
119.71: It is good to me, that thou hast made me meek; that I learn thy justi-fyings.
119.72: The law out of thy mouth is better to me; than thousands of gold and silver.
119.73: [[Jod.]] Thine hands made me, and formed me; give thou understanding to me, that I learn thy behests.
119.74: They that dread thee shall see me, and they shall be glad; for I hoped more on thy words.
119.75: Lord, I knew, that thy dooms be equity; and in thy truth thou hast made me meek.
119.76: Thy mercy be made, that it comfort me; by thy speech to thy servant.
119.77: Thy merciful doings come to me, and I shall live; for thy law is my thinking.
119.78: They that be proud be shamed, for unjustly they did wickedness against me; but I shall be exercised in thy behests.
119.79: They that dread thee be turned to me; and they that know thy witnessings.
119.80: Mine heart be made unwemmed in thy justifyings; that I be not shamed.
119.81: [[Caph.]] My soul failed into thine health; and I hoped more in thy word.
119.82: Mine eyes failed into thy speech; saying, When shalt thou comfort me?
119.83: For I am made as a bouget [[or bottle]] in frost; I have not forgotten thy justifyings.
119.84: How many be the days of thy servant; when thou shalt make doom of them that pursue me?
119.85: Wicked men told to me janglings; but not as thy law.
119.86: All thy commandments be truth; wicked men have pursued me, help thou me.
119.87: Almost they ended me in [[the]] earth; but I forsook not thy command-ments.
119.88: By thy mercy quicken thou me; and I shall keep the witnessings of thy mouth.
119.89: [[Lamed.]] Lord, thy word dwelleth in heaven; without end.
119.90: Thy truth dwelleth in generation, and into generation; thou hast founded the earth, and it dwelleth.
119.91: The day lasteth continually by thy ordinances; for all things serve to thee.
119.92: But for thy law was my thinking; then peradventure I had perished in my lowness.
119.93: Without end I shall not forget thy justifyings; for in those [[or them]] thou hast quickened me.
119.94: I am thine, make thou me safe; for I have sought thy justifyings.
119.95: Sinners abode me, for to lose me; I understood thy witnessings.
119.96: I saw the end of all end; thy commandment is full large.
119.97: [[Mem.]] Lord, how loved I [[or I loved]] thy law; all day it is my thinking.
119.98: Above mine enemies thou madest me prudent by thy commandment; for it is to me without end.
119.99: I understood over all men teaching me; for thy witnessings is my thinking.
119.100: I understood above eld [[or old]] men; for I sought thy commandments.
119.101: I forbade my feet from all evil way; that I keep thy words.
119.102: I bowed not from thy dooms; for thou hast set law to me.
119.103: Thy speeches be full sweet to my cheeks; above honey to my mouth.
119.104: I understood of thy behests; there-fore I hated all the ways of wickedness.
119.105: [[Nun.]] Thy word is a lantern to my feet; and a light to my paths.
119.106: I swore, and purposed steadfastly; to keep the dooms of thy rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]].
119.107: I am made low by all things; Lord, quicken thou me by thy word.
119.108: Lord, make thou well pleasing the willful things of my mouth; and teach thou me thy dooms.
119.109: My soul is ever[[more]] in mine hands; and I forgat not thy law.
119.110: Sinners setted a snare to me; and I erred not from thy commandments.
119.111: I purchased thy witnessings by heritage without end; for those [[or they]] be the full [[out]] joying of mine heart.
119.112: I bowed mine heart to do thy justifyings without end; for reward.
119.113: [[Samech.]] I hated wicked men; and I loved thy law.
119.114: Thou art mine helper, and mine up-taker; and I hoped more in thy word.
119.115: Ye wicked men, bow away from me; and I shall seek the command-ments of my God.
119.116: Up-take thou me by thy word, and I shall live; and shame thou not me for mine abiding.
119.117: Help thou me, and I shall be safe; and I shall bethink ever[[more]] in thy justifyings.
119.118: Thou hast forsaken all men going away from thy dooms; for the thought of them is unjust.
119.119: I areckoned all the sinners of earth to be breakers of the law; therefore I loved thy witnessings.
119.120: Nail thou my flesh with thy dread; for I dreaded of thy dooms.
119.121: [[Ain.]] I did doom and rightwise-ness; betake thou not me to them that falsely challenge me.
119.122: Take up thy servant into goodness; they that be proud challenge not me.
119.123: Mine eyes failed into thine health; and into the speech of thy rightful-ness [[or rightwiseness]].
119.124: Do thou with thy servant after thy mercy; and teach thou me thy justify-ings.
119.125: I am thy servant; give thou under-standing to me, that I know thy witnessings.
119.126: Lord, it is time to do; they have destroyed thy law.
119.127: Therefore I loved thy command-ments; more than gold and topaz.
119.128: Therefore I was dressed to all thy behests; I hated all wicked way.
119.129: [[Pe.]] Lord, thy witnessings be wonderful; therefore my soul sought those [[or them]].
119.130: Declaring of thy words lighteneth; and it giveth understanding to meek men.
119.131: I opened my mouth, and drew the spirit; for I desired thy commandments.
119.132: Behold thou on me, and have mercy on me; by the doom of them that love thy name.
119.133: Dress thou my goings by thy speech; that all unrightfulness have not lordship on me.
119.134: Again-buy thou me from the false challenges of men; that I keep thy behests.
119.135: Lighten thy face on thy servant; and teach thou me thy justifyings.
119.136: Mine eyes led forth the outgoings of waters; for they kept not thy law.
119.137: [[Tzaddi.]] Lord, thou art just [[or rightwise]]; and thy doom is rightful [[or right]].
119.138: Thou hast commanded rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]], thy witnessings; and thy truth greatly to be kept.
119.139: My fervent love made me to be melted, either languished; for mine enemies forgat thy words.
119.140: Thy speech is set afire; and thy servant loved it.
119.141: I am young, and despised; I forgat not thy justifyings.
119.142: Lord, thy rightfulness [[or rightwise-ness]] is rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]] without end; and thy law is truth.
119.143: Tribulation and anguish have found me; thy behests is my thinking.
119.144: Thy witnessings is equity without end; give thou understanding to me, and I shall live.
119.145: [[Koph.]] I cried in all mine heart, Lord, hear thou me; I shall seek thy justifyings.
119.146: I cried to thee, make thou me safe; that I keep thy commandments.
119.147: I before came in ripeness, and I cried; I hoped above on thy words.
119.148: Mine eyes before came to thee full early; that I should bethink on thy speeches.
119.149: Lord, hear thou my voice by thy mercy; and quicken [[or enliven]] thou me by thy doom.
119.150: They that pursue me nighed to wickedness; forsooth they be made far from thy law.
119.151: Lord, thou art nigh; and all thy ways be truth.
119.152: In the beginning I knew of thy witnessings; for thou hast founded those [[or them]] without end.
119.153: [[Resh.]] See thou my meekness, and deliver thou me; for I forgat not thy law.
119.154: Deem thou my doom, and again-buy thou me; quicken thou me for thy speech.
119.155: Health is far from sinners; for they sought not thy justifyings.
119.156: Lord, thy mercies be many; quicken thou me by thy doom.
119.157: They be many that pursue me, and do tribulation to me; I bowed not away from thy witnessings.
119.158: I saw breakers of the law, and I was melted, either languished; for they kept not thy speeches.
119.159: Lord, see thou, for I loved thy commandments; quicken thou me in thy mercy.
119.160: The beginning of thy word is truth; all the dooms of thy rightwise-ness be without end.
119.161: [[Schin.]] Princes pursued me with-out cause; and my heart dreaded of thy words.
119.162: I shall be glad on thy speeches; as he that findeth many spoils.
119.163: I hated and loathed wickedness; forsooth I loved thy law.
119.164: I said praisings to thee seven times in the day; on the dooms of thy rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]].
119.165: Much peace is to them that love thy law; and no cause of stumbling is to them.
119.166: Lord, I abode thine health; and I loved thy behests.
119.167: My soul kept thy witnessings; and loved those [[or them]] greatly.
119.168: I kept thy commandments, and thy witnessings; for all my ways be in thy sight.
119.169: [[Tau.]] Lord, my beseeching come nigh in thy sight; by thy speech give thou understanding to me.
119.170: Mine asking enter into thy sight; by thy speech deliver thou me.
119.171: My lips shall tell out an hymn; when thou hast taught me thy justi-fyings.
119.172: My tongue shall pronounce thy speech; for why all thy command-ments be equity.
119.173: Thine hand be made, that it save me; for I have chosen thy behests.
119.174: Lord, I coveted thine health; and thy law is my thinking.
119.175: My soul shall live, and it shall praise thee; and thy dooms shall help me.
119.176: I erred as a sheep that perished; Lord, seek thy servant, for I forgat not thy commandments.

120.1: The song of degrees. When I was set in tribulation, I cried to the Lord; and he heard me.
120.2: Lord, deliver thou my soul from wicked lips; and from a guileful tongue.
120.3: What shall be given to thee, either what shall be laid to thee; to a guileful [[or treacherous]] tongue?
120.4: Sharp arrows of the mighty; with coals that make desolate.
120.5: Alas to me! for my dwelling in an alien land is made long, I dwelled with men dwelling in Kedar;
120.6: my soul was much time a come-ling. I was peaceable with them that hated peace;
120.7: when I spake to them, they impugned, either against-said, me with-out cause.

121.1: The song of degrees. I raised mine eyes to the hills; from whence help shall come to me.
121.2: Mine help is of the Lord; that made heaven and earth.
121.3: The Lord give not thy foot into moving; neither he nap, that keepeth thee.
121.4: Lo! he shall not nap, neither sleep; that keepeth Israel.
121.5: The Lord keepeth thee; the Lord is thy protection above thy right hand.
121.6: The sun shall not burn thee by day; neither the moon by night.
121.7: The Lord keep thee from all evil; the Lord keep thy soul.
121.8: The Lord keep thy going in and thy going out; from this time now and into the world.

122.1: The song of degrees of David. I am glad in these things, that be said to me; We shall go into the house of the Lord.
122.2: Our feet were standing; in thy halls or foreyards, thou Jerusalem.
122.3: Jerusalem, which is builded as a city; whose partaking thereof is into the same thing.
122.4: For the lineages, the lineages of the Lord, ascended [[or went up]] thither, the witnessing of Israel; to acknowl-edge to the name of the Lord.
122.5: For they sat there on seats in doom; seats on the house of David.
122.6: Pray ye those things, that be to the peace of Jerusalem; and abundance be to them that love thee.
122.7: Peace be made in thy strength; and abundance in thy towers.
122.8: For my brethren and my neigh-bours; I spake peace of thee.
122.9: For the house of our Lord God; I sought goods to thee.

123.1: The song of degrees. To thee I have raised mine eyes; that dwellest in heavens.
123.2: Lo! as the eyes of servants be in the hands of their lords. As the eyes of the handmaid be in the hands of her lady; so our eyes be to our Lord God, till he have mercy on us.
123.3: Lord, have thou mercy on us, have thou mercy on us; for we be much filled with despising.
123.4: For our soul is much filled; we be shame to them that be abundant with riches, and despising to proud men.

124.1: The song of degrees of David. Israel say now, No but for the Lord was in us;
124.2: no but for the Lord was in us. When men rose up against us;
124.3: in hap they had swallowed us quick. When the strong vengeance of them was wroth against us;
124.4: in hap water had swallowed us up. Our soul passed through a strand [[or stream]];
124.5: in hap our soul had passed through a water unsufferable.
124.6: Blessed be the Lord; that gave not us into taking [[or catching]] of the teeth of them.
124.7: Our soul, as a sparrow, is delivered; from the snare of hunters. The snare is all-broken; and we be delivered.
124.8: Our help is in the name of the Lord; that made heaven and earth.

125.1: The song of degrees. They that trust in the Lord be as the hill of Zion; he shall not be moved without end, that dwelleth in Jerusalem.
125.2: Hills be in the compass of it, and the Lord is in the compass of his people; from this time now, and into the world.
125.3: For the Lord shall not leave the rod of sinners on the part of just [[or rightwise]] men; that just men hold not forth their hands to wickedness.
125.4: Lord, do thou well to good men; and to rightful [[or right]] in heart.
125.5: But the Lord shall lead them that bow into obligations, with them that work wickedness; peace be upon Israel.

126.1: The song of degrees. When the Lord turned the captivity of Zion; we were made as comforted.
126.2: Then our mouth was filled with joy; and our tongue with full out joying. Then they shall say among heathen men; The Lord magnified to do with them.
126.3: The Lord magnified to do with us; we be made glad.
126.4: Lord, turn thou our captivity; as a strand [[or stream]] in the south.
126.5: They that sow in tears; shall reap in full out joying.
126.6: They going, went, and wept; sending their seeds. But they coming, shall come with full out joying; bearing their handfuls.

127.1: The song of degrees of Solomon. No but or But if the Lord build the house; they that built it have travailed in vain. No but or But if the Lord keepeth the city; he waketh in vain that keepeth it.
127.2: It is vain to you to rise before the light; rise ye after ye have set, that eat the bread of sorrow. When he shall give sleep to his loved;
127.3: lo! the heritage of the Lord is sons, the meed is the fruit of [[the]] womb.
127.4: As arrows be in the hand of the mighty; so the sons of them that be shaken out.
127.5: Blessed is the man, that hath [[full-]]filled his desire of those [[or them]]; he shall not be shamed, when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

128.1: The song of degrees. Blessed be all men, that dread the Lord; that go in his ways.
128.2: For thou shalt eat the travails of thine hands; thou art blessed, and it shall be well to thee.
128.3: Thy wife shall be as a plenteous vine; in the sides of thine house. Thy sons as the new springs of olive trees; in the compass of thy board.
128.4: Lo! so a man shall be blessed; that dreadeth the Lord.
128.5: The Lord bless thee from Zion; and see thou the goods of Jerusalem in all the days of thy life.
128.6: And see thou the sons of thy sons; see thou peace on Israel.

129.1: The song of degrees. Israel say now; Oft they have fought against me from my youth.
129.2: Oft they [[have]] fought against me from my youth; and soothly they might not to me
129.3: Sinners forged on my back; they made long their wickedness.
129.4: The Lord is just [[or rightwise]], he shall beat the nolls of sinners;
129.5: all that hate Zion be they shamed, and turned aback.
129.6: Be they made as the hay of housetops; that dried up, before that it be drawn up.
129.7: Of which hay he that shall reap, shall not fill his hand; and he that shall gather handfuls, shall not fill his bosom.
129.8: And they that passed forth said not, The blessing of the Lord be on you; we blessed you in the name of the Lord.

130.1: The song of degrees. Lord, I cried to thee from the depths;
130.2: Lord, hear thou my voice. Thine ears be made attentive into the voice of my beseeching.
130.3: Lord, if thou keepest wickednesses; Lord, who shall sustain, or abide?
130.5: and, Lord, for thy law I abode thee. My soul sustained in his word;
130.6: my soul hoped in the Lord. From the morrowtide keeping till to the night;
130.7: Israel hope in the Lord. For why mercy is at the Lord; and plenteous redemption is at him.
130.8: And he shall again-buy Israel; from all the wickednesses thereof.

131.1: The song of degrees to David. Lord, mine heart is not enhanced; neither mine eyes be raised. Neither I went in great things; neither in marvels above me.
131.2: If I feeled not meekly; but [[I]] en-hanced my soul. As a child weaned on his mother; so yielding be in my soul.
131.3: Israel, hope in the Lord; from this time now and into the world.

132.1: The song of degrees. Lord, have thou mind on David; and of all his mildness.
132.2: As he swore to the Lord; he made a vow to [[the]] God of Jacob.
132.3: I shall not enter into the taber-nacle of mine house; I shall not ascend [[or go up]] into the bed of my resting.
132.4: I shall not give sleep to mine eyes; and napping to mine eyelids.
132.5: And rest to my temples, till I find a place to the Lord; a tabernacle to [[the]] God of Jacob.
132.6: Lo! we heard that the ark of the testament is in Ephratah [[or we have heard of it in Ephratah]]; we found it in the fields of the wood.
132.7: We shall enter into the tabernacle of him; we shall worship in the place, where his feet stood.
132.8: Lord, rise thou into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thine hallowing.
132.9: Thy priests be clothed with right-fulness [[or rightwiseness]]; and thy saints make full out joy.
132.10: For David, thy servant; turn thou not away the face of thy christ.
132.11: The Lord swore in truth to David, and he shall not make him [[in]] vain; Of the fruit of thy womb I shall set on thy seat.
132.12: If thy sons shall keep my testament; and my witnessings, these which I shall teach them. And the sons of them till into the world; they shall set on thy seat.
132.13: For the Lord chose Zion; he chose it into a dwelling to himself.
132.14: This is my rest into the world of world; I shall dwell here, for I chose it.
132.15: I blessing shall bless the widow of it; I shall [[ful]] fill with loaves the poor men of it.
132.16: I shall clothe with health the priests thereof; and the holy men thereof shall make full out joy in full out joying or rejoicing.
132.17: Thither I shall bring forth the horn of David; I [[have]] made ready a lantern to my christ.
132.18: I shall clothe his enemies with shame; but mine hallowing shall flower out on him.

133.1: The song of degrees. Lo! how good and how merry it is; that brethren dwell together.
133.2: As ointment in the head; that goeth down into the beard, into the beard of Aaron. That goeth down into the collar of his cloth;
133.3: as the dew of Hermon, that goeth down into the hill of Zion. For there the Lord sent blessing; and life till into the world, that is, without end.

134.1: The song of degrees. Lo! now bless ye the Lord; all the servants of the Lord. Ye that stand in the house of the Lord; in the halls or foreyards of the house of our God.
134.2: In nights raise your hands into holy things; and bless ye the Lord.
134.3: The Lord bless thee from Zion; the which Lord made heaven and earth.

135.1: Alleluia. Praise ye the name of the Lord; ye servants of the Lord, praise ye.
135.2: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord; in the halls or foreyards of the house of our God.
135.3: Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good; sing ye to his name, for it is sweet.
135.4: For the Lord chose Jacob to him-self; [[and]] Israel into possession to himself.
135.5: For I have known, that the Lord is great; and our God before all gods.
135.6: The Lord made all things, what-ever things he would, in heaven and in earth; in the sea, and in all depths of waters.
135.7: He led out clouds from the farthest part of [[the]] earth; and made light-nings into rain. Which bringeth forth winds from his treasures [[or treasuries]];
135.8: which killed the first begotten things of Egypt, from man unto beast.
135.9: He sent out signs and great wonders, in the middle of thee, thou Egypt; into Pharaoh, and into all his servants.
135.10: Which smote many folks; and killed strong kings.
135.11: Sihon, the king of Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan; and all the realms of Canaan.
135.12: And he gave the land of them heritage; to be heritage to Israel, his people.
135.13: Lord, thy name is without end; Lord, thy memorial be in generation and into generation.
135.14: For the Lord shall deem his people; and he shall be prayed in his servants.
135.15: The simulacra of heathen men be silver and gold; the works of the hands of men.
135.16: Those images have a mouth, and shall not speak; those [[or they]] have eyes, and shall not see.
135.17: Those [[or they]] have ears, and shall not hear; for there is no spirit in the mouth of them.
135.18: They that make those [[things]], be made like them; and all that trust in them.
135.19: The house of Israel, bless ye the Lord; the house of Aaron, bless ye the Lord.
135.20: The house of Levi, bless ye the Lord; ye that dread the Lord, bless ye the Lord.
135.21: Blessed be the Lord of Zion; that dwelleth in Jerusalem.

136.1: Alleluia. Acknowledge ye to the Lord, for he is good; for his mercy is without end.
136.2: Acknowledge ye to the God of gods.
136.3: Acknowledge ye to the Lord of lords.
136.6: Which made steadfast [[the]] earth on waters.
136.8: The sun into the power of the day.
136.9: The moon and the stars into [[the]] power of the night.
136.10: Which smote Egypt with the first engendered things of them.
136.11: Which led out Israel from the midst of them.
136.12: In a mighty hand, and in an high arm.
136.13: Which parted the Red Sea into partings.
136.14: And led out Israel through the midst thereof.
136.15: And he cast adown Pharaoh and his power, or virtue, in the Red Sea.
136.16: Which led over his people through [[the]] desert.
136.20: And Og, the king of Bashan.
136.21: And he gave the land of them to be heritage.
136.23: For in our lowness he had mind on us.
136.24: And he again-bought us from our enemies.
136.25: Which giveth meat to each flesh.
136.26: Acknowledge ye to the God of heaven. Acknowledge ye to the Lord of lords; for his mercy is without end.

137.1: On the floods of Babylon, there we sat, and wept; while we bethought on Zion.
137.2: In sallows in the midst thereof; we hanged up our organs.
137.3: For they that led us prisoners; asked us there the words of songs. And they that led away us said; Sing ye to us an hymn of the songs of Zion.
137.4: How shall we sing a song of the Lord; in an alien land?
137.5: If I forget thee, Jerusalem; my right hand be given to forgetting.
137.6: My tongue cleave to my cheeks; if I bethink not on thee. If I purposed not of thee, Jerusalem; in the beginning of my gladness.
137.7: Lord, have thou mind on the sons of Edom; for the day of Jerusalem. Which say, Extinguish ye, extinguish ye; till to the foundament therein.
137.8: Thou wretched daughter of Bab-ylon; he is blessed, that yieldeth to thee thy yielding, which thou yieldest to us.
137.9: He is blessed, that shall hold; and hurtle down his little children at the stone.

138.1: [[The psalm of David.]] Lord, I shall acknowledge to thee in all mine heart; for thou heardest the words of my mouth. My God, I shall sing to thee in the sight of angels;
138.2: I shall worship toward thine holy temple, and I shall acknowledge to thy name. On thy mercy and thy truth; for thou hast magnified thine holy name above all things.
138.3: In whatever day I shall inwardly call thee, hear thou me; thou shalt multiply virtue in my soul.
138.4: Lord, all the kings of earth acknowl-edge to thee; for they heard all the words of thy mouth.
138.5: And sing they in the ways of the Lord; for the glory of the Lord is great.
138.6: For the Lord is high, and behold-eth meek things; and knoweth afar high things.
138.7: If I shall go in the midst of tribu-lation, thou shalt quicken me; and thou stretchedest forth thine hand on the ire of mine enemies, and thy right hand made me safe.
138.8: The Lord shall yield for me, Lord, thy mercy is without end; despise thou not the works of thine hands.

139.1: To victory, the psalm of David. Lord, thou hast proved me, and hast known me;
139.2: thou hast known my sitting, and my rising again. Thou hast understood my thoughts from [[a]] far;
139.3: thou hast inquired of my path and my cord. And thou hast before-seen all my ways;
139.4: for no word is in my tongue. Lo! Lord, thou hast known all things,
139.5: the new things and eld [[or old]]; thou hast formed me, and hast set thine hand on me.
139.6: Thy knowing is made wonderful of me; it is comforted, and I shall not be able to it.
139.7: Whither shall I go from thy spirit; and whither shall I flee from thy face?
139.8: If I shall ascend [[or go up]] into heaven, thou art there; if I shall go down into hell, thou art present.
139.9: If I shall take my feathers full early; and shall dwell in the last parts of the sea.
139.10: And soothly thither thine hand shall lead me forth; and thy right hand shall hold me.
