139.11: And I said, In hap darknesses shall defoul me; and the night is my lightening in my delights.
139.12: For why darknesses shall not be made dark from thee, and the night shall be lightened as the day; as the darknesses thereof, so and the light thereof.
139.13: For thou haddest in possession my reins; thou tookest me up from the womb of my mother.
139.14: I shall acknowledge to thee, for thou art magnified dreadfully; thy works be wonderful, and my soul shall know that full much.
139.15: My bone, which thou madest in private, is not hid from thee; and my substance formed in the lower parts of [[the]] earth.
139.16: Thine eyes saw mine unperfect thing, and all men shall be written in thy book; days shall be formed, and no man is in those [[or them]].
139.17: Forsooth, God, thy friends be made honourable full much to me; the prince-hood of them is comforted full much.
139.18: I shall number them, and they shall be multiplied above the gravel; I rose up, and yet I am with thee.
139.19: For thou, God, shalt slay sinners; ye men-quellers, bow away from me.
139.20: For they say in thought; Take they their cities in vanity.
139.21: Lord, whether I hated not them that hated thee; and I failed, that is, mourned greatly, on thine enemies?
139.22: By perfect hatred I hated them; they were made enemies to me.
139.23: God, prove thou me, and know thou mine heart; ask thou me, and know thou my paths.
139.24: And see thou, if way of wicked-ness is in me; and lead thou me forth in [[the]] everlasting way.

140.1: To victory, the psalm of David. Lord, deliver thou me from an evil man; deliver thou me from a wicked man.
140.2: Which thought wickednesses in the heart; all day they ordained battles.
140.3: They sharpened their tongues as serpents; the venom of snakes is under the lips of them.
140.4: Lord, keep thou me from the hand of the sinner; and deliver thou me from wicked men. Which thought to deceive my goings;
140.5: proud men hid a snare to me. And they laid forth cords into a snare; they setted a trap to me beside the way.
140.6: I said to the Lord, Thou art my God; Lord, hear thou the voice of my beseeching.
140.7: Lord, Lord, the virtue of mine health; thou madest a shadow on mine head in the day of battle.
140.8: Lord, betake thou not me from my desire to the sinner; they thought against me, forsake thou not me, lest peradventure they be enhanced.
140.9: The head of the compass of them; the travail of their lips shall cover them.
140.10: Coals shall fall on them, thou shalt cast them down into fire; into wretchednesses where they shall not be able to stand.
140.11: A man that is a great jangler shall not be dressed [[or rightforth ruled]] in earth; evils shall take an unjust man into perishing.
140.12: I have known, that the Lord shall make doom of a needy man; and the vengeance of poor men.
140.13: Nevertheless just [[or rightwise]] men shall acknowledge to thy name; and rightful [[or right]] men shall dwell with thy cheer.

141.1: The psalm of David. Lord, I cried to thee, hear thou me; give thou attention to my voice, when I shall cry to thee.
141.2: My prayer be dressed as incense in thy sight; the raising up of mine hands be as the eventide sacrifice.
141.3: Lord, set thou a keeping to my mouth; and a door of standing about to my lips.
141.4: Bow thou not [[down]] mine heart into words of malice; to excuse excusings in sin. With men working wickedness; and I shall not commune with the chosen men of them.
141.5: A just [[or rightwise]] man shall reprove me in mercy, and he shall blame me; but the oil of a sinner make not fat mine head. For why and yet my prayer is in the well pleasant [[or well pleased]] things of them;
141.6: for the doomsmen of them joined to the stone were sopped up. Hear they my words, for they were mighty.
141.7: As fatness is broken out on the earth; our bones be scattered nigh hell.
141.8: Lord, Lord, for mine eyes be to thee, I hoped in thee; take thou not away my soul.
141.9: Keep thou me from the snare which they ordained to me; and from the traps of them that work wickedness.
141.10: Sinners shall fall in the net thereof; I am alone till I pass by.

142.1: The learning of David; his prayer, when he was in the den. With my voice I cried to the Lord; with my voice I prayed heartily to the Lord.
142.2: I shedded [[or poured]] out my prayer in his sight; and I pronounced my tribulation before him.
142.3: While my spirit faileth of me; and thou hast known my paths. In this way in which I went; proud men hid a snare to me.
142.4: I beheld to the right side, and I saw; and none there was that knew me. Flight perished from me; and none there is that seeketh to help my soul.
142.5: Lord, I cried to thee; I said, Thou art mine hope; my part in the land of livers.
142.6: Give thou attention to my beseech-ing; for I am made low full greatly. Deliver thou me from them that pur-sue me; for they be comforted on or over me.
142.7: Lead my soul out of keeping to acknowledge to thy name; just [[or rightwise]] men abide me, till thou yield to me.

143.1: The psalm of David. Lord, hear thou my prayer, with ears perceive thou my beseeching; in thy truth hear thou me, in thy rightwiseness.
143.2: And enter thou not into doom with thy servant; for each man living shall not be made just [[or justified]] in thy sight.
143.3: For the enemy pursued my soul; he made low my life in [[the]] earth. He hath set me in dark places, as the dead men of the world,
143.4: and my spirit was anguished on me; mine heart was troubled in me.
143.5: I was mindful of eld [[or old]] days, I bethought in all thy works; I be-thought in the deeds of thine hands.
143.6: I held forth mine hands to thee; my soul was as earth without water to thee.
143.7: Lord, hear thou me swiftly; my spirit failed. Turn thou not away thy face from me; and I shall be like them that go down into the pit.
143.8: Make thou early thy mercy heard to me; for I hoped in thee. Make thou known to me the way in which I shall go; for I raised my soul to thee.
143.9: Deliver thou me from mine enemies; Lord, I fled to thee;
143.10: teach thou me to do thy will, for thou art my God. Thy good spirit shall lead me forth into a rightful [[or right]] land;
143.11: Lord, for thy name thou shalt quicken me in thine equity. Thou shalt lead my soul out of tribulation;
143.12: and in thy mercy thou shalt scatter mine enemies. And thou shalt lose all them, that trouble my soul; for I am thy servant.

144.1: A psalm of David. Blessed be my Lord God, that teacheth mine hands to war; and my fingers to battle.
144.2: My mercy, and my refuge; my taker-up, and my deliverer. My defender, and I hoped in him; and thou makest subject my people under me.
144.3: Lord, what is a man, for thou hast made thyself known to him; either the son of man, for thou areckonest him of some value?
144.4: A man is made like vanity; his days pass as a shadow.
144.5: Lord, bow down thine heavens, and come thou down; touch thou [[the]] hills, and they shall make smoke.
144.6: Light thou shining, and thou shalt scatter them; send thou out thine arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.
144.7: Send out thine hand from on high, ravish me out, and deliver thou me from many waters; and from the hand of alien sons.
144.8: The mouth of whom spake vanity; and the right hand of them is the right hand of wickedness.
144.9: God, I shall sing to thee a new song; I shall say psalm to thee in psaltery of ten strings.
144.10: Which givest health to kings, which again-boughtest David, thy servant; from the wicked sword ravish thou out me.
144.11: And deliver thou me from the hand of alien sons; the mouth of which spake vanity, and the right hand of them is the right hand of wickedness.
144.12: Whose sons be as new plantings in their youth. The daughters of them be arrayed; adorned about as the likeness of a temple.
144.13: The cellars of them be full; bring-ing out from this vessel into that, or from one vessel into another. The sheep of them be with lambs, plenteous [[or abounding]] in their goings out;
144.14: their kine be fat. There is no falling of their wall, neither passing over of it; neither cry is in the streets of them.
144.15: They said, The people is blessed, that hath these things; blessed is the people, whose Lord is the God of it.

145.1: The psalm of David. My God, king, I shall enhance thee; and I shall bless thy name into the world, and into the world of world.
145.2: By all days I shall bless thee; and I shall praise thy name into the world, and into the world of the world.
145.3: The Lord is great, and worthy to be praised full much; and none end there is of his greatness.
145.4: Generation and generation shall praise thy works; and they shall pro-nounce, either tell afar, thy power.
145.5: They shall speak of the magnifi-cence of the glory of thine holiness; and they shall tell of all thy marvels.
145.6: And they shall say of the strength of thy fearedful things; and they shall tell of thy greatness.
145.7: They shall bring forth the mind of the abundance of thy sweetness; and they shall tell with full out joying of thy rightfulness [[or rightwiseness]].
145.8: The Lord is a merciful doer and merciful in will; patient, and much merciful.
145.9: The Lord is sweet in all things; and his merciful doings be above all his works.
145.10: Lord, all thy works acknowledge to thee; and thy saints bless thee.
145.11: They shall say [[of]] the glory of thy realm; and they shall speak of thy power.
145.12: That they make thy power known to the sons of men; and the glory of the magnificence of thy realm.
145.13: Thy realm is the realm of all worlds; and thy lordship is in all generation and into generation. The Lord is faithful in all his words; and holy in all his works.
145.14: The Lord lifteth up all that fall down; and raiseth up all men hurtled down.
145.15: Lord, the eyes of all beasts hope in thee; and thou givest the meat of them in covenable time.
145.16: Thou openest thine hand; and thou [[ful]] fillest each beast with blessing.
145.17: The Lord is just [[or rightwise]] in all his ways; and holy in all his works.
145.18: The Lord is nigh to all that inward-ly call him; to all that inwardly call him in truth.
145.19: He shall do the will of them, that dread him; and he shall hear the beseeching of them, and he shall make them safe.
145.20: The Lord keepeth all men loving him; and he shall lose all sinners.
145.21: My mouth shall speak the praising of the Lord; and each man bless his holy name into the world, and into the world of world.

146.1: Alleluia. My soul, praise thou the Lord;
146.2: I shall praise the Lord in my life; I shall sing to my God as long as I shall be.
146.3: Do not ye trust in princes; neither in the sons of men, in whom is no health.
146.4: The spirit of him shall go out, and he shall turn again into his earth; in that day all the thoughts of them shall perish.
146.5: He is blessed, of whom the God of Jacob is his helper; his hope is in his Lord God,
146.6: that made heaven, and earth; the sea, and all things that be in those [[or them]]. Which keepeth truth into the world,
146.7: he maketh doom to them that suffer wrong; he giveth meat to them that be hungry. The Lord unbindeth fettered men;
146.8: the Lord lighteneth blind men. The Lord raiseth men hurled or hurtled down; the Lord loveth just men.
146.9: The Lord keepeth comelings; he shall take up a motherless child, and a widow; and he shall destroy the ways of sinners.
146.10: The Lord shall reign into the worlds; Zion, thy God shall reign in generation and into generation.

147.1: Alleluia. Praise ye the Lord, for the psalm is good; let our praising be merry, and fair to our God.
147.2: The Lord shall build [[up]] Jerusalem; and he shall gather together the scatterings of Israel.
147.3: The which Lord maketh whole men contrite in heart; and bindeth together the sorrows of them.
147.4: Which numbereth the multitude of stars; and calleth names to all those [[or them]].
147.5: Our Lord is great, and his virtue is great; and of his wisdom there is no number.
147.6: The Lord taketh up mild men; forsooth he maketh low sinners till to the earth.
147.7: Before sing ye to the Lord in acknowledging; say ye psalm to our God in an harp.
147.8: Which covereth heaven with clouds; and maketh ready rain to the earth. Which bringeth forth hay in hills; and herb to the service of men.
147.9: Which giveth meat to their work beasts; and to the birds of crows calling him.
147.10: He shall not have will in the strength of an horse; neither it shall be well pleasant [[or well pleased]] to him in the legs of a man.
147.11: It is well pleasant [[or well pleased]] to the Lord on men that dread him; and in them that hope in his mercy.
147.12: Jerusalem, praise thou the Lord; Zion, praise thou thy God.
147.13: For he hath comforted the locks of thy gates; he hath blessed thy sons in thee.
147.14: Which hath set thy coasts peace; and filleth thee with the fatness of wheat.
147.15: Which sendeth out his speech to the earth; his word runneth swiftly.
147.16: Which giveth snow as wool; he spreadeth abroad a cloud as ashes.
147.17: He sendeth his crystal as morsels; who shall be able to suffer before the face of his coldness?
147.18: He shall send out his word, and shall melt those [[or them]]; his spirit shall blow, and waters shall flow.
147.19: Which telleth his word to Jacob; and his rightfulnesses and dooms to Israel.
147.20: He did not so to each nation; and he showed not his dooms to them.

148.1: Alleluia. Ye of heavens, praise the Lord; praise ye him in high things.
148.2: All his angels, praise ye him; all his virtues, praise ye him.
148.3: Sun and moon, praise ye him; all stars and light, praise ye him.
148.4: Heavens of heavens, praise ye him; and the waters that be above heavens,
148.5: praise they the name of the Lord. For he said, and things were made; he commanded, and things were made of nought.
148.6: He ordained those things into the world, and into the world of world; he setted a commandment, and it shall not pass.
148.7: Ye of the earth, praise the Lord; dragons, and all depths of waters.
148.8: Fire, hail, snow, ice, spirits of tempests; that do his word.
148.9: Mountains, and all little hills; trees bearing fruit, and all cedars.
148.10: Wild beasts, and all tame beasts; serpents, and feathered birds.
148.11: The kings of earth, and all peoples; the princes, and all judges of earth.
148.12: Young men, and virgins, eld [[or old]] men with [[the]] younger,
148.13: praise the name of the Lord; for the name of him alone is enhanced. His acknowledging be on heaven and earth;
148.14: and he hath enhanced the horn of his people. An hymn be to all his saints; to the children of Israel, to a people nighing to him.

149.1: Alleluia. Sing ye to the Lord a new song; his praising be in the church of saints.
149.2: Israel be glad in him that made him; and the daughters of Zion make full out joy in their king.
149.3: Praise they his name in a quire or choir; say they psalm to him in a tympan, and psaltery.
149.4: For the Lord is well pleased in his people; and he hath raised mild men into health.
149.5: Saints shall make full out joy in glory; they shall be glad in their beds.
149.6: The full out joyings of God in the throat of them; and swords sharp on both sides in the hands of them.
149.7: To do vengeance in nations; and blamings in peoples.
149.8: To bind the kings of them in stocks; and the noble men of them in iron manacles.
149.9: That they make in them the doom written; this is the glory to all his saints.

150.1: Alleluia. Praise ye the Lord in his saints; praise ye him in the firmament of his virtue.
150.2: Praise ye him in his virtues; praise ye him by the multitude of his greatness.
150.3: Praise ye him in the sound of a trump; praise ye him in a psaltery and harp.
150.4: Praise ye him in a tympan and quire; praise ye him in strings and organ.
150.5: Praise ye him in cymbals sounding well, praise ye him in cymbals of jubilation;
